### Summary

  Workspace has become an essential tool for managing multiple packages.
  Therefore, we need `uv workspace xxx` to provide more concise and clear functionality in workspace management scenarios. Although some features may only require adding fixed parameter aliases to the original `uv xxx` in workspace scenarios, this can simplify users' understanding of the available workspace features and clarify the direction of workspace development.

```shell
uv workspace init
uv workspace add
uv workspace remove
uv workspace sync
uv workspace lock
uv workspace run
uv workspace tree
uv workspace build
uv workspace publish
```
